note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up. Billed: SharePoint Premium (Syntex) pay-as-you-go through an empty resource group, about 0.10 USD for the recording. The model itself cannot be created by script: teach it in the content center the day before (6 training contracts as positives, 3 invoices as negatives, extractors Contract number and Expiry date labelled in at least 5 contracts, then apply it to Purchasing > SupplierDocuments), and link billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center first.
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
az group create --name rg-mglab-sharepoint-10 --location westeurope --output none   # owner runs az login first
# manual, day before: pay-as-you-go billing link, content center /sites/ContentCenter, model 'Supplier Contract' taught and applied to SupplierDocuments

screens.name: billing
steps: Open Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Pay-as-you-go services
Hold on the linked Azure subscription and the resource group rg-mglab-sharepoint-10
Hold on the extractors 'Contract number' and 'Expiry date' and the counts of example files
mask: admin host in the address bar

screens.name: upload
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
screens.note: Device-code sign-in off camera. The third command should print no Upload lines (files already there).

screens.name: library
steps: Show the columns Content type, Contract number, Expiry date and Classification Date (add them to the view if needed)
Hold on scan_0001.pdf: Supplier Contract with both values; scan_0002.pdf and meeting-notes.pdf are not classified
Record what really happens (classification can take up to 24 hours; capture the next day if empty)
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar

screens.name: report
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
screens.note: Record what it really says (DL005/DL006 or 'No findings.') and compare with the library screen.

teardown: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
# manual: remove the model from SupplierDocuments (content center > Models > Supplier Contract > Applied libraries), delete the content type and extractor columns, delete the model
# manual: Microsoft 365 admin center > Org settings > Pay-as-you-go services > disconnect the subscription (stops billing)
needs: manual:teach the model in the content center
